status: Predeclared exploratory supplements, frozen before any held-out retrieval outputs. These do not modify the nine-method primary policy or its aggregate.

stopwords.source: Default lexical stopword sets exported from pinned Lucene 9.12.3 analyzers. Empty or unsupported sets remain explicitly labeled; POS-based stop filtering is outside this word-list ablation.
stopwords.normalization: Run every source stopword through the prototype exact analyzer for the configured language. Retain only entries yielding exactly one normalized surface token. Ignore empty or multi-token entries and report counts. Analyze queries again in stem mode and assert token texts/fingerprint equal the primary cached analysis.
stopwords.filter: For unquoted queries, remove a token only if its normalized SURFACE is in that language's normalized stopword set. Match surfaces, not stems. Keep all quoted phrases unchanged. If removing stopwords would empty a query, retain its original tokens and record the fallback.
stopwords.matching: OR unique remaining stem terms; MSM requires ceil(0.6 * remaining unique stem terms). Exact lane and indexed documents remain unchanged. Reuse the same primary prototype stem FTS index at both corpus sizes.
stopwords.report: Separate from primary methods: source/protocol hashes, available/empty/unsupported language counts, per-query removed/would-remove/original/remaining token counts, quote/fallback counts, retrieval metrics and development-only calibration, paired uncertainty versus native stem OR. No stopword or query text in reports.

lemmatization.analysis: Use the prototype EXACT-token cache for the first 10,000 nested corpus documents and the identical selected queries. NFC each token, apply Simplemma 2.0.0 DefaultStrategy for the known language, then lowercase. Empty or whitespace-bearing lemma outputs fall back to the input token. No Snowball after lemmatization. One flat lemma per input position. Cache repeated word lookups.
lemmatization.ranking: Separate FTS5 lemma lane, content/title weights 1/2 and identical rowid/hash ties. OR unique lemma terms; explicitly quoted queries retain a phrase. Fuse stem and lemma ranks with fixed RRF k=60, input depth1000, output100; never add raw BM25 scores.
lemmatization.report: Only the predeclared 11-language 10k subset is aggregated, separately from primary17. Preserve all judgments and queries, unsupported languages explicit. Per-language and matched-language macro quality/calibration and paired uncertainty versus native stem OR. Analysis/index/timing costs labeled as research costs.

shared.queries: Exactly the original frozen development/test queries and corpora; no tuning, resampling, or selection on test scores.
shared.uncertainty: Same 1000 paired query bootstrap replicates and 95% unadjusted intervals as primary, comparing each supplement against native stem OR on the identical language/query/corpus subset.
shared.privacy: Commit metrics, public IDs, hashes and counts only. Text-bearing caches and stopword lists remain external.
